# Route L: original Green poles and complete boundary residues

- **ID:** L-C50
- **Date:** 2026-09-12
- **Stage:** 1-in-progress; conjecture and source audit
- **Depends on:** C44 actual weighted source; C48 complete original jump; C49 actual Green Mellin identity
- **RH status:** unproved

Chain: complete original Green/BV source → fixed physical-reader agreement
→ conormal vanishing → RH. C49 now identifies the actual weighted primitive
and preserves the native Xi coefficient. The hard gap remains the fixed
physical comparison, including every boundary face and normalization.

## Conjecture

For the actual damping-two source f, original prime p, and L=log(p), set
`Q(s)=M(f)(s)/(1-exp(-sL))`. C49 identifies Q with the literal original
Green transform on `0<Re(s)<2`; C44/C45 admit the numerator on `-1<Re(s)<2`.
For every integer k, let `s_k=-2*pi*i*k/L`. Conjecture: Q is meromorphic
on the latter strip, has a simple pole at every s_k, and

`residue(Q,s_k)=M(f)(s_k)/L=Fourier(f)(k/L)/L`.

The last quantity is precisely C48's k-th original Fourier coefficient of
the complete two-ended jump. The frequency sign and original measure are
part of the identity. No circle rescaling or boundary subtraction is allowed.

## Direct proof mechanism to verify

The numerator is analytic and nonzero at each s_k by the actual source
results. Prove that the denominator vanishes there and has derivative L;
then apply an audited simple-zero quotient/trailing-coefficient theorem.
Use C44's literal Fourier/Mellin equality and C48's original coefficient
formula to identify the residue with the same complete boundary. Check the
actual Lean definition of residue/trailing coefficient before claiming an
order or sign. This remains unproved in Lean at this checkpoint.

## Comparison obligation

Even equality of every residue and jump coefficient does not identify the
fixed Burnol/Deninger physical reader on the degree-six Green/BV boundary.
The next step must assemble these same contributions with Tate depth,
multiplicity, native Xi coefficient, Gamma normalization, and horizontal
anchor retained. A residue deletion, a fitted reader, or an assumed
conservation law cannot supply that comparison.

The full zero-indexed norm bound for the reciprocal prime denominator and
literal polynomial-moment formulas for all Green derivatives remain
separate obligations. C49 proves the derivatives of the actual integral
function and native Xi response; it does not identify all those derivatives

## C28. The neutral finite part is the nonzero Bockstein current

The singular residue in (C27.6) kills only the logarithmic coefficient.  Its natural finite part
does not vanish.  Indeed, with \(H_N=\sum_{k\le N}k^{-1}\), the ordered diagonal cutoff of (C27.1)
is

\[
  \sum_{k\le N}d_k(B_n)
   ={1\over n}H_N-{1\over n}H_{\lfloor N/n\rfloor}.
\tag{C28.1}
\]

Since \(H_N-\log N\to\gamma\),

\[
  \boxed{
  \lim_{N\to\infty}\sum_{k\le N}d_k(B_n)={\log n\over n}>0.}
\tag{C28.2}
\]

On the other hand differentiating the exact modular anomaly gives

\[
  {d\over da}\Phi_a(B_n)\bigg|_{a=0^+}
   ={d\over da}\left[{1\over n}(1-e^{-a\log n})\right]_{a=0}
   ={\log n\over n}.
\tag{C28.3}
\]

Thus the finite-part trace of the Wold--Green boundary is exactly the first Bockstein jet of the
physical KMS anomaly.  It is source-native, strictly positive, and cannot be removed by changing
the logarithmic-residue representative.

This falsifies a stronger form of the remaining producer:

> a pre-divisor Stokes trace identity, analytic in horizontal grade, annihilates the physical
> Wold--Green boundary on a grade neighbourhood.

Such an identity would make every derivative at neutral grade vanish, contradicting (C28.2)--
(C28.3).  The new `SourceHorizontalWoldNeutralJetBridge.lean` is the all-prime version of this
fact: after a uniformly positive gauge, the neutral Gamma-Bockstein jet is the literal Wold
coefficient, and its adjacent-prime correction is the Route-T residual increment.

Therefore the final source theorem cannot be a grade-flat Stokes law, an analytic deformation of
the singular trace, or a common normal KMS state.  It must be both:

1. divisor-selective -- it may vanish only on the actual Xi support, not on an open grade family;
2. nonlinear/nonlocal -- it must consume a quadratic reflection-paired or relative-index object,
   since every linear trace sees either the nonzero finite part or only the zero logarithmic
   residue.

The two reflected modular anomalies satisfy the exact self-product law

\[
  -\Phi_a(B_n)\Phi_{-a}(B_n)
   ={4\over n^2}\sinh^2\!\left({a\log n\over2}\right)\ge0,
\tag{C28.4}
\]

with equality exactly at \(a=0\).  This is the Wold--Green normal form of the Gauss--Hodge mass
current.  Hence the sole surviving producer is now explicit: a coefficient-faithful arithmetic
relative-index pairing must identify its source-exact signed self-product with (C28.4).  Proving
that identification would annihilate the positive mass and close RH; assuming it would merely
rename RH.

**Route status:** still open.  C27--C28 eliminate positive KMS, common fixed-ideal, analytic
grade-flat, and linear singular-trace producers.  They leave one precise quadratic relative-index
comparison, not a terminal death proof.

**Status:** paper proof and Lean formalization complete.  Module
`RHTower/RouteRDegreeSixBVGreenNeutralFinitePart.lean` identifies the scalar coefficient with the
actual BV--Green boundary operator, proves the exact harmonic cutoff (C28.1), its limit (C28.2),
the neutral modular derivative (C28.3), and their equality.  In particular,
`deningerDegreeSixBVGreenNeutralBocksteinJet_ne_zero` and
`not_tendsto_deningerDegreeSixBVGreenDiagonalCutoff_zero` formally exclude grade-flat trace
annihilation at degree six.  Targeted module build and axiom audit pass with only
`[propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]`.

## C29. Closed positive descent also erases the prime atom

C25 used bounded Riesz representation.  The same obstruction holds for unbounded positive forms
as soon as they are closed, so passing from bounded GNS data to an honest closed quadratic form
does not rescue the retained class.

Let \(H=\ell^2(\mathbb Q^\times)\), let \(U=U_p\) be prime dilation, and let
\(D\subset H\) be a dense \(U\)-invariant linear domain.  Let
\(q:D\times D\to\mathbb C\) be a positive sesquilinear form, closed for

\[
  \|x\|_q^2=\|x\|_H^2+q(x,x).
\tag{C29.1}
\]

Assume homological descent in the minimal diagonal form

\[
  q((U-1)x,(U-1)x)=0\qquad(x\in D).
\tag{C29.2}
\]
